headline: 本周影剧：误杀瞒天记3热映，魔女嘉莉首播
summary: 今日影剧看点：电影《误杀瞒天记3》《另一个妈咪》热度领先；新剧《魔女嘉莉》《乌鸦学园》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》持续热播。待映还有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《误杀瞒天记3》《另一个妈咪》领跑本周关注。
industryHighlights.en: Movie buzz: 'Drishyam 3' and 'Another Mommy' lead this week's attention.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《魔女嘉莉》《乌鸦学园》等本周上线。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: 'Carrie' and 'Crow Academy' arrive this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《母狮》持续升温。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: 'Reacher,' 'Lanterns,' and 'Lioness' keep heating up.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《街头霸王》等受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: 'Avengers 5,' 'Dune 3,' and 'Street Fighter' draw anticipation.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Drishyam 3 Hits, Carrie Premieres
summaryEn: Today's film & TV picks: 'Drishyam 3' and 'Another Mommy' lead movie buzz; 'Carrie' and 'Crow Academy' premiere this week, while 'Reacher' and 'Lanterns' stay hot. Upcoming: 'Avengers 5' and 'Dune 3'.
